The '''gwayo bird''' was an animal native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. The native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]], [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for gwayo [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. The process involved simply tracking the birds to their nests.

When the Sakiyan [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] was hunting [[Ghostling]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he realized that he could similarly follow the movements of the Ghostlings' [[Wistie/Legends|Wistie]] allies to locate the children.
